description: Verbatim stenographic records of chamber floor sessions (GET /v1/floor-transcripts), newest first: each sitting's date, session type, length and official PDF. Coverage: the New York Senate, every sitting from 2025 on. Read one with get_floor_transcript. For committee hearings use list_hearings.

since.description: ISO date; sittings on or after it.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. NY), DC, or US for Congress.

until.description: ISO date; sittings on or before it.

name: list_floor_transcripts
title: List floor-session transcripts
